subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should #93383 remain the specific coordination issue for stale lock plus subagent delivery after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError, or should maintainers fold it into the broader #101863 run-lifecycle design after sequencing the open candidate PRs?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans session fence semantics, subagent delivery durability, channel typing cleanup, and broader run lifecycle invariants; automation should not choose the ownership boundary while overlapping PRs are still open.

options.title: Keep #93383 as the specific tracker
